# DAYSPAN

## Product
- Product name: Field Overshirt
- Sales channel: DAYSPAN online shop
- Color: Clay
- Color code: #8A6754
- Composition: 100% cotton
- Fabric: plain weave
- Fabric weight: 220 g/m²
- Surface: matte
- Stretch: none
- Fit: relaxed, straight cut
- Collar: pointed
- Front fastening: six dark brown buttons
- Pocket: one left chest patch pocket
- Cuffs: one dark brown button per cuff
- Hem: straight
- Back: straight horizontal yoke
- Overview sample size: M

## Range and finished garment measurements
| SKU | Name | Price | Flat chest width (mm) | Back length (mm) | Shoulder width (mm) | Sleeve length (mm) |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| DS-FO-S | Field Overshirt / S | USD 68 | 540 | 680 | 460 | 580 |
| DS-FO-M | Field Overshirt / M | USD 68 | 570 | 700 | 480 | 590 |
| DS-FO-L | Field Overshirt / L | USD 68 | 600 | 720 | 500 | 600 |

## Measurement definitions
- Object: finished garment, laid flat with front buttons fastened
- Flat chest width: straight across from underarm to underarm; one flat width
- Back length: center back, from collar attachment seam to hem
- Shoulder width: across the back between sleeve attachment seams
- Sleeve length: shoulder seam to cuff edge along the outer sleeve
- Diagram scale reference: 100 mm

## Model and wearing states
- Image source: generated adult model
- Model continuity: one person across all wearing imagery
- Height: 172 cm
- Body chest circumference: 92 cm
- Body waist circumference: 76 cm
- Body hip circumference: 98 cm
- Worn size: M
- Front fastening state: all six buttons fastened
- Cuff state: fastened
- Supporting clothing: plain off-white trousers
- Standing state: front view, arms relaxed
- Seated state: three-quarter view, upright on a plain stool
- Reaching state: side view, arms extended forward at shoulder height
- Video duration: 10 seconds
- Video sequence: standing 0–3 seconds; sitting 3–6 seconds; reaching forward 6–10 seconds

## Fixed copy
| Content | Exact text |
| --- | --- |
| Brand | DAYSPAN |
| Product | Field Overshirt |
| Price | USD 68 |
| Composition | 100% cotton |
| Fit | Relaxed fit |
| Size table heading | Garment measurements (mm) |
| Model disclosure | AI-generated model |

## Image geometry
- Coordinate origin: upper left
- Square hero proportion: 1:1
- Square hero background: #FFFFFF
- Square hero garment bounding-box height: 85–88% of canvas height
- Square hero garment bounding-box width: at most 90% of canvas width
- Square hero garment envelope: x 5–95%, y 2–90%
- Square hero text band: y 92–100%
- Back overview and close-up proportion: 3:2
- Back overview and close-up caption band: y 88–100%
- Wearing images, size comparison and detail page proportion: 2:3
- Portrait information bands: y 0–18% and y 72–92%
- Portrait primary image area: y 18–72%
- Vertical cover and video proportion: 9:16
- Vertical information bands: y 0–18% and y 72–92%
- Vertical primary image area: y 18–72%
- Model disclosure band: y 92–100%, aligned left
- Model disclosure minimum letter height: 5% of frame shorter side
- Other copy minimum letter height: 2% of frame shorter side
- Detail page upper image area: front and back overviews, two close-ups, three wearing states
- Detail page lower information band: size table and model body measurements

## Reference context
- Atmosphere: ordinary home hallway before a morning commute
- Materials: painted plaster, light wood, canvas and cotton
- Light: soft daylight

steps.userMessage:
DAYSPAN | Fit and size visuals for the Field Overshirt

We are preparing the Field Overshirt product page for DAYSPAN's own online shop. Buyers need to see where the shoulder falls, how the hem sits and what changes when they sit down or reach forward. The garment is fixed: a relaxed, straight-cut overshirt in Clay #8A6754, made from 100% cotton plain weave at 220 g/m², with a matte surface and no stretch. It has a pointed collar, six dark brown front buttons, one left chest patch pocket, single-button cuffs, a straight hem and a straight back yoke.

The range contains three size SKUs: DS-FO-S, Field Overshirt / S; DS-FO-M, Field Overshirt / M; and DS-FO-L, Field Overshirt / L. Each costs USD 68. Finished garment measurements in mm, ordered as flat chest width, back length, shoulder width and sleeve length, are S: 540, 680, 460, 580; M: 570, 700, 480, 590; L: 600, 720, 500, 600. All wearing views use size M on the same generated adult model, with height 172 cm, chest 92 cm, waist 76 cm and hips 98 cm. Use standing, seated and forward-reaching poses with the front fully buttoned and cuffs fastened. Print "AI-generated model" at the lower left of every image containing the model and throughout the video, with letter height at least 5% of the frame's shorter side.

The square front hero, vertical video cover and product detail page must each print "DAYSPAN", "Field Overshirt" and "USD 68". Use "100% cotton" and "Relaxed fit" on the detail page and video cover. The size comparison graphic and detail page must label their garment tables "Garment measurements (mm)". The square hero uses a white background, a garment bounding-box height of 85–88% of the canvas and the bottom 8% for its text. The attached geometry diagram sets the corresponding text bands for the other images.

Audience: online clothing buyers choosing a size and judging how the overshirt will look during everyday movement.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the product, size, model and layout facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every delivery file with its proportion, format and stage. garment-measurements.png supplies the measurement points and three-size garment table. shop-image-geometry.png supplies the image proportions, product envelope and text bands. overshirt-front.png fixes the front construction and Clay color. overshirt-back.png fixes the back yoke, hem and silhouette. overshirt-collar.png fixes the collar, placket and fabric surface. overshirt-cuff.png fixes the cuff fastening and stitching. morning-hallway.png supplies an everyday commuting atmosphere.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page selling-point and information hierarchy table, with priority, destination images and minimum letter height for the product name, price, fabric, fit, measurements and model disclosure
2. A one-page shot and image list covering ten still images and one video, with each image's role, proportion, pose or crop, and printed content
3. Two garment overview images: one square front hero and one back view, both showing the complete size M garment
4. Two close-up images: collar and placket; cuff and sleeve seam, each with a fabric composition caption
5. Three size M wearing images: standing front view, seated three-quarter view and forward-reaching side view, each with the model's four body measurements and worn size
6. One size comparison graphic containing all three SKU names, codes, prices and four garment measurements, plus a size M measurement drawing and a labeled 100 mm scale bar
7. One portrait product detail page combining the garment views, two detail crops, three wearing states and complete three-size table
8. One vertical video cover using the standing wearing view, with the product name, price, fabric composition and fit descriptor
9. One 10-second vertical movement video showing standing at 0–3 seconds, sitting at 3–6 seconds and reaching forward at 6–10 seconds
10. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing both early tables and the final imagery, with a page locating each fixed product fact in the delivered work

Acceptance:
- The hierarchy table records DAYSPAN, Field Overshirt, USD 68, 100% cotton, Relaxed fit and the size M values 570, 700, 480 and 590 mm; the hero repeats the name and price, the cover repeats the name, price, composition and fit, and the detail page repeats all of these facts. The shot list assigns all ten still images and the video their numbered roles.
- Both overview images, both close-ups, all three wearing images, the detail page, cover and video preserve the Clay #8A6754 garment and the construction in the four identity attachments. The front overview shows six front buttons and the left chest pocket; the back overview shows the straight yoke; the close-ups show the pointed collar, single-button cuff and matte plain weave.
- The size comparison graphic and detail page reproduce all three SKU codes, names, USD 68 prices and twelve garment measurements. Both use Garment measurements (mm); the graphic identifies flat chest width, back length, shoulder width and sleeve length on its size M drawing, with the 100 mm bar at the same scale.
- The three wearing images, detail page, cover and video use the same model in size M, with the fastening and poses specified above. The wearing images and detail page print height 172 cm, chest 92 cm, waist 76 cm and hips 98 cm separately from garment measurements; every image containing the model and every video frame carries AI-generated model in the specified lower-left position and minimum letter height.
- The square hero, portrait detail page and vertical cover follow shop-image-geometry.png, including the hero's 85–88% garment height and bottom 8% text band. The detail page retains the two close-ups and all three wearing states at readable sizes within its stated text zones.
- The 10-second video follows the three timed movements and ends with DAYSPAN, Field Overshirt and USD 68. The presentation contains at least eight pages, reproduces both early tables, reuses all ten final still images and includes a three-frame video sequence; its fact-location page names the final image or video segment carrying each product, size and model fact.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
